notes.title: Speed Balance Update
notes.content: Halved the speed on Miners, Refineries and Assemblers to make game more idle and bets more useful. Also fixed Fullscreen Button and added a few extra save points

notes.title: Small Day One Patch
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing my game and for the great reception. Here's just a tiny patch to make sure that Steam Achievements properly update while in game. I also made a few mid game items worth more to make the progression feel smoother towards all those expensive items.

Thanks again,
Max
